issues.description: Inconsistent signature for Milkable.messageOnMilk: the problem statement specifies a parameterized method "messageOnMilk(double milkVolume)" and requires the returned string to include the volume, but the UML diagram and the provided code (template Main usage and solution Milkable interface/implementations) define and call a parameterless "messageOnMilk()". This makes it unclear which method students must implement and prevents implementing the milk-volume requirement without changing the interface and all call sites.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all artifacts consistent by choosing one signature: (A) update the problem statement to require "messageOnMilk()" without volume and adjust the described output accordingly, or (B) update the UML, template (Main and any calls), and solution interfaces/implementations to "messageOnMilk(double milkVolume)" and include volume formatting in returned strings.

issues.description: Animal sound example contradicts the specified Seal implementation: the introduction gives an example where a Seal might make an ethereal "moo", but later the task explicitly requires Seal.messageOnFeed() to return "Arf Arf!" (and the solution implements "Arf Arf!"). This can mislead students about expected outputs for the song verses, which are based on messageOnFeed().
issues.suggestedFix: Edit the introductory example to avoid using "moo" for Seal (or clearly mark it as a non-binding example), and keep the explicit required outputs (e.g., Seal: "Arf Arf!", Pig: "Oink!", Goat: "Maah!") consistent throughout the statement.
